result.question: Compare R&D spending as a share of revenue across Tesla, Apple, and Nvidia in their most recent fiscal years.
result.answer:
In their most recent fiscal years, R&D spending as a share of revenue was as follows:

**Tesla (FY 2025, ended December 31, 2025):** R&D expense was $6.411 billion and total revenue was $94.827 billion, yielding an R&D-to-revenue ratio of approximately 6.8% [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2025-12-31] [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2025-12-31]. Tesla's 10-K also reports R&D as 7% of revenues for FY 2025 [0001628280-26-003952:item-7-p017].

**Apple (FY 2025, ended September 27, 2025):** R&D expense was $34.55 billion and net sales (revenue) was $416.161 billion, yielding an R&D-to-revenue ratio of approximately 8.3% [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2025-09-27] [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2025-09-27].

**Nvidia (FY 2026, ended January 25, 2026):** R&D expense was $18.497 billion and total revenue was $215.938 billion, yielding an R&D-to-revenue ratio of approximately 8.6% [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2026-01-25] [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:Revenues:2026-01-25]. Nvidia's 10-K also confirms R&D was 8.6% of revenue for FY 2026 [0001045810-26-000021:item-7-p007].

### Retracted claims

The following claims could not be verified against their cited sources and were removed from the answer:
- Based on the cited figures, Tesla had the lowest R&D intensity at roughly 6.8%, while Apple and Nvidia were comparable at approximately 8.3% and 8.6%, respectively.
- In absolute dollars, Apple spent the most on R&D at $34.55 billion, followed by Nvidia at $18.497 billion, and Tesla at $6.411 billion.
